topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the topic of cancer evolution and outlines the learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Genetic Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Regulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer progression is driven by the Darwinian selection of advantageous somatic mutations and non-mutational changes in epigenetic state.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue hierarchies and stem cell properties govern tumor initiation and propagation across different cancer models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Influences on Tumor Growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how inflammatory stimuli, microenvironmental signals, and supportive stroma enable mutant cells to progress into malignant and sustained tumors.

topics.label: Experimental and Computational Methods for Investigating Tumor Biology
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the single-cell sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and computational approaches used to study tumor evolution and microenvironments.

topics.label: Synthesis of the Multi-Factor Evolutionary Model of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates the genetic, epigenetic, cellular, and microenvironmental forces that collectively shape tumor evolution.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Lecture Preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
